items.headline: Air Force hosts UConn in Week 9
items.description: UConn (4-3) at Air Force (5-2), Oct. 31 at 3 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Tyler Hughes throws 2 TD passes, runs for score in Wyoming's 28-14 victory over Air Force
items.description: — Tyler Hughes finished with two touchdown passes and a touchdown run to propel Wyoming to a 28-14 victory over the Air Force Academy on Friday night.

items.headline: Can Week 8 up the ante again with more upsets and drama?
items.description: With plenty of SEC drama last week, could Week 8 bring even more chaos?

items.headline: Air Force takes on Wyoming in MWC action
items.description: Air Force (5-1) at Wyoming (4-3), Oct. 23 at 9 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Week 7's best game? Impossible to choose on a wild Saturday
items.description: With five top-seven teams losing and dramatic finishes across the board, college football brought the heat in Week 7.

items.headline: Medders leads Air Force ground attack with 3 TDs in Air Force's 41-31 win over UNLV
items.description: — Quarterback Evan Medders ran for 152 yards and three touchdowns, and Air Force took control in the fourth quarter to beat UNLV 41-31 on Saturday.
